'''Carnovia''' was a [[Water/Legends|humid]] [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] located in the [[Carnovia system/Legends|Carnovia system]], a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. The [[Kaaga Run/Legends|Kaaga Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Circumtore system/Legends|Circumtore]] and [[Nar Kaaga system/Legends|Nar Kaaga systems]]. The depths of Carnovia were inhabited by gigantic creatures known as the [[Carnovian eel]]s. On that world,<ref name="TEA" /> many<ref name="LoNH" /> beings [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked at pens where young Carnovian [[Eel/Legends|eels]] were raised due to the Hutts considering them [[Foodstuff/Legends|delicacies]].<ref name="TEA" /> Besides eel [[Farm/Legends|farming]], Carnovia was also known for the production of foodstuffs in general.<ref name="LoNH" />

Carnovia served as the base of operations of the Hutt [[Vermilic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]], and the [[Floating Palace]] of the clan's leader [[Minalod]] was situated at the center of a large lake and was surrounded by eel pens of various depths. The Vermilic kidnapped [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from enslaved species to develop counterfeit versions of in-demand processed foods, which the Hutts then distributed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The best of those scientists worked and lived at the Floating Palace.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I wanted star systems that were associated with the Hutts and would thus give Hutt Space the right 'feel.' That put worlds such as Cyborrea, Carnovia, and Sionia onto the map ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
Carnovia originated&mdash;via a mention of the Carnovian eel&mdash;in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' by [[A. C. Crispin]].<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> It was later established as a world by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu.com]], Fry noted that Carnovia was chosen for inclusion on the book's map of Hutt Space due to being associated with the Hutts and thereby increasing the region's recognizability to the reader.<ref name="Suvudu" />
